verdict.rationale: Delegating work to an agent from a chat thread is a fair ask for an agent-orchestration platform like HumanLayer, but nothing in the pack shows tagging an agent in a chat thread. The Slack integration only pushes task artifact updates out to channels. The GitHub, Linear and Jira integrations create tasks from issues, not from @mentions in a conversation, and the multiplayer drafts and task comments are in-app collaboration features, not a way to tag an agent.
